name: Temporal/Spatial Vector Quantization
definition: Two methods for multivariate time-varying volumes: one grouping voxels in the temporal domain and the other in the spatial domain, then applying vector quantization algorithms to corresponding blocks.
summary: Temporal/Spatial Vector Quantization compresses time-varying volumes by grouping voxels into temporal or spatial blocks to exploit coherence, distinguishing itself from static or purely spatial methods through adaptive dimension selection.
